question: What certified LFD bounds hold on a preregistered panel of 190 fresh presentations at n=33..45 and n=47..51, including a separate trace-zero n=33 stratum?

claims.text: When the independently checked codimension lower bound exceeds the exact exhaustive solution count, the named presentation has last fall degree at least D+1.

arms.description: 190 fresh inputs; degree four on all, degree five on the 50 frontier inputs if memory admission permits.
Independent checker and exhaustive count, correctness reference without repeated closure execution.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Deterministic exact certificates, no runtime or frequency inference; historical digest replay measures exact reproducibility.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Historical 13-certificate replay is the positive correctness control, with hash identity and independent checking; software counter validation covers 188 full enumerations and four batch-boundary cross-checks.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No stochastic null inference. Corrupted certificate rejection and small all-pairs solution counts test false acceptance in software validation.

factors.name: input
factors.how: Per-instance seed from SHA256 of SEMAEV-PANEL-20261029-v1 plus newline plus stable instance id; Python Random and exact generator source frozen.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: C source, M4RI commit and binary SHA256 retained.

factors.name: host
factors.how: CPU, kernel, process memory ceiling and L0 wall-valid=false; no timing inference.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Plan order, two workers; independent exact computations.

comparisons.threshold: Checker accepts and exact count < certified codimension; otherwise no LFD lower bound.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

seed_derivation.note: seed = first 8 big-endian bytes of SHA256(UTF8(SEMAEV-PANEL-20261029-v1 + newline + fresh-n{n}-{family}-{rep:02d})); generator expand_instances.py is source-hashed.

instance_sampling.rule: For every integer n=33..45 and 47..51, five polynomial-subspace and five independently random-subspace draws; plus ten trace-zero subspaces at n=33. k=ceil(n/2); random nonsingular binary curve; z a nonzero rational point abscissa. No filtering for solvability, degree or trivial trace refutation. All draws retained.

blinding.how: Exact deterministic verification; labels required to reconstruct inputs, no blinded statistical analysis.

power.note: Descriptive ten-per-n panel requested by owner, plus separate trace-zero stratum. Not powered for population-frequency or asymptotic conclusions.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Per-command watchdog scheduling envelope, not runtime prediction. Historical certificates.txt supplies only lower-n planning observations.

primary.name: certified codimension lower bound
primary.definition: nq from an independently accepted surjective closure-separating map; not equality with closure codimension.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Per-instance retained results; no in-progress algebra checkpoint. Infra retry uses new attempt and reconciles locks.

stopping_rules.rule: 190 fixed fresh input draws, 190 degree-four attempts and 50 degree-five admission requests; six-hour watchdog per child command; memory refusals and failures retained without replacement.
Hash mismatch, checker failure, missing completion or timeout leaves a failed record and retained bytes.

invalidation_rules: Unverified certificate yields no certified lower bound.
No public archive claim until anonymous download and SHA256 readback.

decision_rule.text: For each input and D, infer LFD >= D+1 only if the checker accepts and exact solution count is smaller than certified codimension. Resource refusal, timeout or absent certificate is unknown.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: per-instance lower bound, no population inference

graphs: per-instance certificate status, no timing graph

inadmissible: Equating ker(pi) and W4 solely from checker acceptance.
Calling nonmembership alone an unsatisfiability proof.
Claiming an F4 trace establishes an exact LFD.
Claiming a private object store is a public archive.

literature.claim: Prior empirical degree five and distinct first-fall definition.
